proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration lifecycle: new config fields are validated, defaulted, env-overridden, stored, and synchronized across ranks (init/comm structures). Add device-topology because src/graph/paths.cc materially changes P2P channel-per-peer computation and max-peer-based channel tuning for remote/network peers. Add enqueue because runtime planning/graph behavior changes are substantive: strong-stream graph-mixing semantics and P2P scheduling channel limits are updated in enqueue/strongstream paths.
